data.title: Curbie Robot Aims to End Trash Bin Dragging Chores
data.description: Revere Robotics is building Curbie, an autonomous device that clamps onto standard two-wheel trash bins, rolls them to the curb and back using the bin's own wheels, and manages loads over 120 pounds even on icy sidewalks. Safety features like tilt detection stop it if needed and alert owners, while it auto-releases for garbage trucks. The project is in prototype stage with field trials planned, drawing excitement for practical robotics alongside questions about cost and durability.
